text:
maria-ng: Heads-up — planning a preflight for promoting the staging overlay -> prod during the 3pm PT window. Primary things to validate: KMS secret path change, image tag pinning, and terraform state move for secrets. Posting quick checklist and commands here.

devon: Quick Q — did we bump the ingress-controller CPU/memory for prod? Last canary spiked ~60% CPU and I want to avoid thundering herd on rollout.

owen: I added a kustomize patch that sets imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent for prod overlays, and pinned tags in the prod kustomization. CI still injects tags sometimes — need to confirm the pipeline respects pinned tags.

jun: Note: infra/terraform has a change that renames secret paths from `/staging/` -> `/prod/`. Plan looks non-destructive, but migrating state will require `terraform state mv` steps. I'll handle the state ops during the maintenance window.

maria-ng: Can someone run these two commands in staging and paste outputs?
```bash
# show plan for secrets module
cd infra/terraform && terraform plan -target=module.secrets

# kubectl diff of prod overlay (locally against cluster)
kubectl diff -f overlays/prod -n redwood || true
```

devon: Running now — will paste results in a sec. Also I'll verify ingress HPA limits.

deploy-bot: Promotion pipeline status: staging -> prod promotion queued. Requires approvals: [infra-approvers] and successful smoke tests (smoke-tests-prod job). See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4872 :rocket:

owen: :thumbsup: I can approve from infra-approvers once Jun confirms the `terraform state mv` sequence is in the PR runbook.

jun: Plan for state migration (will run in maintenance):
```bash
# example state move steps
cd infra/terraform
terraform state mv module.secrets.aws_secretsmanager_secret.staging[0] module.secrets.aws_secretsmanager_secret.prod[0]
# then re-run plan/apply for module.secrets only
terraform plan -target=module.secrets && terraform apply -target=module.secrets -auto-approve
```
Also KMS key in use: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/prod-keys` — will rotate after verify.

maria-ng: Thanks. Devon — can you paste the `kubectl diff` snippet? If there's any networkpolicy change that blocks metrics, we'll hold.

devon: kubectl diff output (trimmed):
```diff
--- deployments.apps/metrics-agent (current)
+++ deployments.apps/metrics-agent (overlay/prod)
@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
   spec:
     template:
       spec:
+        imagePullSecrets:
+        - name: reg-creds
         containers:
           - name: metrics-agent
             image: gcr.io/redwood/metrics-agent:20260207-9a3f
```
No networkpolicy obs — monitoring namespace still allowed to talk to kubelet.

maria-ng: OK great. Two action items before 2:45pm PT: (1) Jun will add the exact `terraform state mv` commands to the PR runbook; (2) Owen will confirm CI won't rewrite pinned tags. If both done, I'll kick the promotion at 3pm PT. Tagging @sre-oncall for visibility in case we need rollback steps.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged — I'll be on standby and have rollback playbook ready (image rollback + re-pin overlay to previous kustomize commit).

maria-ng: If anything changes, shout here. Otherwise I'll start promote at 15:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
